prompt:
You write realistic phone-call wording for a clinic scheduling test set.
For each scenario below, write what the caller would actually say for each listed field, the way a
note-taking assistant would record the caller's own words for that field (a short phrase, not a full
sentence; keep natural fillers like "I'm in", "near", "over by" when they fit). Vary the style across
scenarios: casual, terse, older caller, non-native speaker, rambling. Do not add facts that are not in
the scenario, and do not add any other place, doctor or service.

Return ONLY a JSON array, one object per scenario: {"id": ..., "<field>": "...", ...} with exactly the
fields listed for that scenario.

Scenarios:
- id nat4-cap-05: Existing patient (with a referral) who needs Breast Ultrasound and insists on going to the clinic called Towson Care Center in Towson, which they always use. Fields: service_phrase = the service: Breast Ultrasound (said naturally); location_phrase = that specific clinic by name: Towson Care Center (not 'near' it)
- id nat4-new-01: A brand-new patient who has never been seen at these clinics needs Couples Therapy. They are in Denver. Fields: service_phrase = the service: Couples Therapy (said naturally); location_phrase = the city: Denver
- id nat4-new-02: A brand-new patient who has never been seen at these clinics needs Weight Management Consultation. They are in San Jose. Fields: service_phrase = the service: Weight Management Consultation (said naturally); location_phrase = the city: San Jose
- id nat4-new-03: A brand-new patient wants Annual Physical with Dr. Calvin Bartley in Las Vegas (a friend recommended this doctor). Fields: service_phrase = the service: Annual Physical (said naturally); provider_phrase = the doctor's full name: Dr. Calvin Bartley; location_phrase = the city: Las Vegas
- id nat4-new-04: A brand-new patient wants Diabetic Foot Exam with Dr. Carlos Ilagan in Chicago (a friend recommended this doctor). Fields: service_phrase = the service: Diabetic Foot Exam (said naturally); provider_phrase = the doctor's full name: Dr. Carlos Ilagan; location_phrase = the city: Chicago
- id nat4-new-05: A brand-new patient who has never been seen here wants Postpartum Visit. They are in San Jose. Fields: service_phrase = the service: Postpartum Visit (said naturally); location_phrase = the city: San Jose
- id nat4-noloc-01: Existing patient who needs a strep test for a sore throat. They do not say where they are at first; asked which city, they answer Miami. Fields: service_phrase = how the caller asks for a strep test for a sore throat; followup_location_phrase = their answer to 'which city?': Miami
- id nat4-noloc-02: Existing patient who needs a CT scan of their chest that their doctor ordered. They do not say where they are at first; asked which city, they answer Portland. Fields: service_phrase = how the caller asks for a CT scan of their chest that their doctor ordered; followup_location_phrase = their answer to 'which city?': Portland
- id nat4-noloc-03: Existing patient who needs an STI test. They do not say where they are at first; asked which city, they answer Detroit. Fields: service_phrase = how the caller asks for an STI test; followup_location_phrase = their answer to 'which city?': Detroit
- id nat4-unoff-01: Existing patient who wants lithotripsy. They are in San Francisco. Fields: service_phrase = the service: lithotripsy (said naturally); location_phrase = the city: San Francisco
- id nat4-unoff-02: Existing patient who wants prenatal genetic counseling. They are in Denver. Fields: service_phrase = the service: prenatal genetic counseling (said naturally); location_phrase = the city: Denver
- id nat4-ring-01: Existing patient who needs eye exam (has any referral needed). They are in Cleveland. Fields: service_phrase = the service: eye exam (said naturally); location_phrase = the city: Cleveland
